direct_gap_statements: The coupled transient equations are now implemented, but the publication does not define enough of the transient protocol to identify one paper-exact bandwidth curve.

direct_cause.statement: The coupled transient equations are now implemented, but the publication does not define enough of the transient protocol to identify one paper-exact bandwidth curve.

root_cause.statement: The dimensionless gamma_parallel convention, random-noise law and seed, integration duration, steady window, mode cutoff, etalon phase, bandwidth estimator, and an unambiguous alpha value are not jointly published.

code_fault_assessment.statement: The replacement campaign integrates both field and gain deterministically and completes a reduced four-depth transient sweep; no remaining code defect was found in this route.

checks.statement: The focused test proves deterministic joint evolution of field and gain with normalized nonzero output.
The runner implements -i H(g) psi and gamma_parallel[g0-g(1+I)] directly from Eqs. (8)-(9), rather than the former stationary proxy.
The frozen reduced transient campaign completed and emitted all five T002 item results.
A full main-paper and embedded-supplement audit enumerated every transient control that is absent from the publication.

next_discriminating_test.action: Obtain the missing transient protocol from the authors or pre-register a sensitivity ensemble and report only the invariant feature envelope.
next_discriminating_test.expected_resolution: A unique protocol would permit paper-scale execution; otherwise the terminal publication boundary remains explicit.

uncovered_item_details.scientific_object: Left-edge state count N_L versus h
direct_gap_statements: Multiple edge-count classifiers are now executable, but the publication does not define which classifier yields N_L and N_R.

direct_cause.statement: Multiple edge-count classifiers are now executable, but the publication does not define which classifier yields N_L and N_R.

root_cause.statement: No edge-state definition, left/right assignment rule, localization threshold, or finite-size tie-breaking rule is published.

code_fault_assessment.statement: The candidate matrix exposes the ambiguity instead of silently selecting one reproduction-authored rule.

checks.statement: The closure campaign emits both boundary-overlap and center/IPR candidates across predeclared windows and thresholds.
All candidate rules and the missing-input schema are frozen in JSON rather than selected from source pixels.
The reduced classifier matrix completed for both N_L and N_R items.

next_discriminating_test.action: Obtain the authors' edge-state classifier or publish the full predeclared classifier sensitivity matrix without claiming one paper-exact curve.
next_discriminating_test.expected_resolution: A published semantic definition would select one path; otherwise the item remains transparently input-blocked.
